description: This is an Android activity Java source file that implements a main screen with a share feature, allowing users to input text and share it via Android's Intent system.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity providing the UI with a text input and a share button, handling the creation of sharing intents.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, configures the toolbar, and sets up the share button click listener.

methods.name: share
methods.description: Creates a text sharing intent with the user's input and launches a chooser for sharing.
